note: Seychelles: a non-Seychellois works, employed or self-employed, only on the Gainful Occupation Permit, sought after the Ministry of Employment's approval certificate and before entering to take up the work, SCR 500 a month. The proposed registration of foreign performers with the creative industries agency isn't modelled. No days without the permit.

sources.title: Immigration and Civil Status (Seychelles), Gainful Occupation Permit
sources.said: (GOP) allows the holder to be gainfully occupied in Seychelles and this could be as an employee or as a self‐employed person. ... The prospective employee must not enter Seychelles for the purpose of taking up employment prior to obtaining the Gainful Occupation Permit.
